code: const out={pings:[]}; for (let i=0;i<4;i++){ const t=Date.now(); await Word.run(async (c)=>{ await c.sync(); }); out.pings.push(Date.now()-t);} const t2=Date.now(); await Word.run(async (c)=>{ const p=c.document.getSelection().paragraphs; p.load("items/text,items/style"); await c.sync(); out.selRead=Date.now()-t2; }); const t3=Date.now(); await Word.run(async (c)=>{ const p=c.document.body.paragraphs.getLast(); p.style="Action"; await c.sync(); out.styleSet=Date.now()-t3; }); return out;
